description: Patbingsu is a beloved Korean shaved ice dessert, perfect for cooling down on a hot day. This refreshing treat features finely shaved ice, generously topped with sweet red bean paste and an array of delightful additions. Our recipe guides you to create an authentic Patbingsu with creamy milk ice and classic toppings right in your kitchen.

ingredients.item: Mini mochi or Injeolmi (Korean rice cakes)

instructions.title: Prepare the Milk Ice Blocks
instructions.text: Pour whole milk into ice cube trays or a shallow container. Freeze for at least 6 hours, preferably overnight, until completely solid. This is crucial for creating creamy shaved ice.

instructions.title: Prepare Toppings
instructions.text: If using fresh mochi or Injeolmi, gently toast them in a dry pan for a few minutes until slightly soft and chewy. Cut them into bite-sized pieces. Slice your strawberries and dice the kiwi. Have your sweet red bean paste and condensed milk ready for assembly.

instructions.title: Shave the Ice
instructions.text: Remove the frozen milk from the freezer. If using ice cubes, process them in a high-powered blender or food processor until they form a fine, snow-like consistency. If using a block, use a dedicated shaved ice machine to create fluffy milk snow.

instructions.title: First Layer of Assembly
instructions.text: Divide the shaved milk ice evenly among four serving bowls. Gently mound the ice in the center of each bowl, creating a fluffy base for your toppings.

instructions.title: Add Sweet Red Bean Paste
instructions.text: Spoon a generous amount of sweet red bean paste over the center of the shaved ice in each bowl. Arrange it nicely around the mound of ice, ensuring a good portion for every bite.

instructions.title: Arrange Toppings
instructions.text: Artfully place the sliced strawberries, diced kiwi, and cut mochi pieces around the red bean paste on top of the shaved ice. Arrange them to create an appealing presentation.

instructions.title: Final Drizzle and Garnish
instructions.text: Drizzle a generous amount of sweetened condensed milk over all the toppings and the shaved ice. For an optional crunch, sprinkle roasted slivered almonds over the top before serving.

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Patbingsu is best enjoyed immediately after assembly to prevent the ice from melting too much. Provide long spoons for easy mixing and eating, allowing everyone to enjoy the layers of flavor.

tips: For the fluffiest shaved ice, freeze milk in a shallow pan rather than ice cube trays, then use a dedicated shaved ice machine if possible. This creates a snow-like texture.
Experiment with toppings! Besides the classics, try adding a scoop of ice cream, cereal flakes, or different fruits like mango or blueberries for a personalized touch.
To make homemade sweet red bean paste, soak dried red beans overnight, then boil until soft. Mash them with sugar and a pinch of salt until you reach your desired sweetness and consistency.
